history.summary: Freehold D15 1BR (818 sqft) at $1.5M / $1,834 psf, 200m from Katong Park TEL — but the URA series shows a negative -1.05%/yr over 27 transactions, meaning this project has actually lost value. An 818 sqft '1BR' at $1.5M is a very large, expensive shoebox with weak demonstrated appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: Negative -1.05%/yr appreciation on a reliable 27-txn series is the decisive fact — capital depreciation over a 5–7yr hold is the opposite of the investment goal. $1.5M for a 1BR (even at 818 sqft) is poor quantum efficiency, and despite the 200m TEL access the project has underperformed. Premium-priced freehold near MRT that still loses value is a clear pass.
red_flags: Negative -1.05%/yr URA appreciation (27 txns) — demonstrated value loss
PSF below $2,069 median yet still falling — structural underperformance

history.summary: Freehold D15 1BR loft (818sqft, Fort Road) priced ~12-15% below its own verified recent transactions. Value, the strongest forward signal, lines up here — the cheapness is real, not a data quirk.
history.rating_rationale: Fulcrum 818sqft one-bedder lofts have transacted at ~$2,054-2,139 psf (March 2023 sale at $2,139; 2024-25 listings $2,054-2,262), with the project averaging ~$2,033 psf over the past year. This unit asks $1,834 psf — a genuine ~12-15% discount, consistent with both the -16.6% age_adj_premium and -16.5% psf_premium_vs_cohort (the 4-txn cohort is thin but I web-verified the discount against actual sales). Freehold, D15 (RCR, ~+3.5% realized fwd), and the unusual 818sqft loft layout that trades at a discount to flat 1BRs. Katong Park MRT (TE24) is ~200m away but already opened June 2024, so treat it as a realized amenity, not a forward re-rating catalyst. Verdict: real value in a strong region; medium confidence because the loft format is a niche, slower-moving resale.
red_flags: 818sqft loft is a niche layout (double-volume, mezzanine) — thinner buyer pool and slower exit than a flat 1BR
psf_cohort_txns only 4 — discount verified on the web rather than from a deep cohort
Katong Park MRT already open (June 2024), so that upside is largely priced in, not forward
catalysts: ~12-15% below verified recent transactions (real value, the leading v3.4 signal)
Freehold tenure in D15 RCR (realized fwd region ~+3.5%)
Walkable to Katong Park MRT (TE24) and East Coast Park; established Tanjong Rhu/Fort Road enclave
